summary: Record a seat's native harness questions as system-only harness-question claims holding ids and option positions, never text, and drop each question a day after it ends

replay.detail: No replay. No existing claim carries the new kinds. A checkpoint proof compares each harness question as of the cut before and after the drop; a question resolved at least a day before the cut answers as gone either way.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes, triggers or schema version change. The claim schema registry gains the harness-question subject family and the system-only kinds harness-question.observed and harness-question.resolved.

rules.detail: Rules version 16 adds the harness question rule: every claim of a pending question is kept; once its resolution was accepted at least a day before the cut, every claim of the question is dropped, the resolution and its answer receipt with it. The rules digest changes, so members seal and verify new checkpoints only once every participant runs rules 16; upgrade all members in one window. Replication and ordinary work are unaffected while they differ.

compatibility.detail: Replication-compatibility event: the claim schema registry digest changes because it gains the harness-question family and its two kinds, so the replication schema digest changes and the existing registry upgrade rules apply. A member on an older build rejects the new kinds at schema admission and keeps them as unknown records until it is upgraded. Nothing writes the new kinds until a harness adapter adopts them; no client action, CLI command or wire field changes in this release.

downtime.detail: No restart requirement beyond the ordinary deploy and no startup work.

manual.detail: Deploy every checkpoint participant to rules 16 together; until then new checkpoints wait at sealing.

recovery.detail: Dropped questions do not come back. Rolling a member back to rules 15 stalls new checkpoints until it runs rules 16 again, and leaves harness-question claims on it as unknown records until it is upgraded again; nothing else needs repair.
